answer: Measure the hardware, not the claim. Each bond is keyed to a hardware root, so two keys on one machine share a root and cannot both bond, and a duplicate submission forfeits the bond on the spot. Auditors rotate, so no panel can be bought for long. In the last sweep 31 of 200 new keys resolved to 9 roots. Nine roots paid nine bonds, not two hundred: the jetty is nine pilings whether or not two hundred boats tie up, and an orchard of labels does not move the count by a whisper.
